description: I'm Minh Hoang Tran, a second-year AI student in the UTS–Bach Khoa TNE program. I'm forming a team to investigate water and climate trends using NASA data and assess water-related risks for AI infrastructure. I'm seeking teammates interested in Python, data analysis, geospatial visualization, web development, or UX/UI design. Together, we'll build a practical, evidence-based prototype through open collaboration.
